name: demo_small on demo_small_c3
description: Generated by assay2chip S5 (s5_group) from the unit operations of 'demo_small' and the chip plan in partition.json: mix, incubate, wash share one board; they run between 20 and 20 C; 5 of the 6 ports allowed at demo scale; 23% of the envelope Built to the demo envelope (30 x 20 mm, 0.3 mm deep, 1 layer). Modules are in flow order, one library part each, in the format chip/designs/README.md defines, so chip/components/build_chip.py runs on this file unchanged.

modules.does: The herringbone mixer mixes a reagent into the stream.
modules.why_no_part: no Flowmatter part in chip/components/catalogue.json has the shape of block 'herringbone_mixer' (assay2chip/parts/flowmatter.py); S6 sizes it from physics instead, so this module has a block but no catalogue shape

modules.does: The serpentine channel is held at temperature.
The polygon chamber is flushed to clear its contents.
modules.why_no_part: no Flowmatter part in chip/components/catalogue.json has the shape of block 'polygon_chamber' (assay2chip/parts/flowmatter.py); S6 sizes it from physics instead, so this module has a block but no catalogue shape

note: chip/components/build_chip.py cannot build this design: module(s) herringbone_mixer_1, polygon_1 sit on blocks that no Flowmatter part in chip/components/catalogue.json has a shape for, and that builder places a library STL per module. Each module's `block` is the authoritative identity and S6 sizes the part from physics through assay2chip/parts/, so the chip is built from this design either way; what is lost is the Flowmatter display model. No part name has been invented to paper over it.
